hook: I want every small business to know when its money will arrive

builtFor.context: Treasury brings business banking and payments together so businesses can receive, store, send and spend money in one place. For a small business, the question underneath all of it is simple: when will I have the money, and is it enough?

opportunities.title: Cash Timeline
opportunities.body: When money becomes available and lands in the bank, day by day.

opportunities.title: Holds, explained
opportunities.body: Reserves shown as a date and a weekly impact, not a pane at the bottom.

opportunities.title: Sooner, when it matters
opportunities.body: Instant payout offered when there's a shortfall, with the trade-off shown.

body: My work has been in financial products where people need to trust what they see: lending at Shecluded, payments at Foodlify, KYC and transaction monitoring at Youverify.
I design for owners who aren't finance experts, and I prototype in code with AI tools, which is how I built the concept in this pitch.

bring.title: Money flows, shipped
bring.body: A 5-step loan flow and dashboard that lifted first-time engagement by 30%.

bring.title: Business payments
bring.body: B2B marketplace checkout at Foodlify that helped lift repeat orders by 31%.

bring.title: AI-assisted prototyping
bring.body: Working prototypes in code, like this one.

systemsGets: Someone who designs the states money can be in (pending, held, in transit, landed) and makes them read the same across the Dashboard.

opportunity.title: Cash Timeline
opportunity.problem: Balances shows incoming and available money, but not when it will be in the bank. Pending funds and reserves reach owners as surprises, a common theme in public reviews.
opportunity.solution: A day-by-day timeline of money becoming available and landing in the bank, checked against payroll, with reserves explained and instant payout offered when there's a gap.

firstWeek.intro: My first week would focus on how small businesses experience cash timing today, then contributing one useful improvement with the team.

days.body: Meet Treasury product, engineering and design. Learn the roadmap for financial accounts and payouts.
Review support tickets and research about payout timing, reserves and cash flow.
Agree on one moment to improve, grounded in evidence.
Prototype it in code and review forecast edge cases with engineering and Risk.
Share findings, the prototype, trade-offs and a test plan with businesses.

ask: I'd love to bring fintech and AI-assisted design experience to Stripe Treasury.
